run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers alongside the GTest group
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and automatically appends the GTest mailing list to CC
refactor_cc_flag_parsing: refactor the CC flag parsing logic in main to support additional email list handling
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that passes all args to upload.py with a default CC address
